messages.subject: Re: negative factor variance
parts:
On 06/06/2016 03:14 PM, annelie...@hotmail.com wrote:
> Hi Everyone,
>
> I am doing a CFA and in my first & second model work fine but when I do
> a third model i get a warning.
> So, I was wondering whether someone could help me with the warning:
> Warning messages:
> 1: In lav_object_post_check(lavobject) :
> lavaan WARNING: some estimated variances are negative

The second warning is just the result of the first (and therefore a bit
redundant).

Negative variances for (latent) variances are often a symptom of model
misfit. It could be due to the data (in particular when the sample size
is small), or it could just be that the model is not correct.

Yves.
